issues.text: The new embed.css and embed.js assets are not added to config.assets.precompile, so in production the embed page and the third-party embed script will 404.
issues.zh: embed.css 與 embed.js 沒有加入 config.assets.precompile，production 會取不到這兩個資產。

issues.text: RSS-imported HTML is stored via the raw_html cook method which completely bypasses PrettyText's sanitize step, and the output is rendered with raw, resulting in stored XSS; the import_remote path has a whitelist but the poll_feed path does not, so the two paths protect asymmetrically.
issues.zh: RSS 匯入的 HTML 以 raw_html cook method 完整繞過 sanitize，成為 stored XSS，且同一支 model 的 import_remote 路徑卻有白名單，兩條路徑的防護不對稱。

issues.text: GET embed/best triggers creation of a Topic and Post as a side effect, violating the safety semantics of the GET method (RFC 9110), which can be triggered by prefetchers, link scanners, or retries.
issues.zh: GET embed/best 會建立 topic 與 post，違反 GET 的安全性語意。

issues.text: force: true was added to an already-merged migration (and to a brand-new migration where it is unnecessary), which will silently DROP and recreate the table (destroying data) if the migration is ever rerun.
issues.zh: force: true 被加到一支已經合併的 migration 上，重跑時會靜默刪掉 top_topics 全部資料；新表 create_topic_embeds.rb 也同樣被加上不必要的 force: true。

issues.text: The disqus.thor rake task's --category option was removed when the import mechanism was switched, so any existing invocation that passes -c/--category will now fail as an unrecognized option.
issues.zh: disqus.thor 的 --category 選項被刪掉，既有帶 -c / --category 的指令會直接失效。

issues.text: The disqus.thor task no longer passes created_at through to post creation, so all imported posts get the current time instead of their original Disqus timestamps, and this is irreversible.
issues.zh: created_at 不再傳遞，匯入的所有文章時間都會變成執行匯入的當下，Disqus export 裡的原始發文時間全部丟失，且不可逆。

issues.text: The disqus.thor task now fetches each URL over HTTP via import_remote instead of parsing the offline XML export directly, and open(url) failures are not rescued, so pages that are offline or moved will break the whole batch import.
issues.zh: 從「用 XML 裡已有的 title / link 建 topic」變成「對每一個 link 發 HTTP 抓網頁再用 Readability 解析」，離線的 XML 匯入變成需要連得到原站，且 open(url) 失敗沒有任何 rescue。

issues.text: embed.js's postMessage origin check uses substring comparison (indexOf) instead of exact-match, so an origin that is merely a string prefix/superset of the configured Discourse URL will pass the check.
issues.zh: embed.js 的 postMessage origin 檢查用子字串比對，前綴相同的網域會通過。

issues.text: Two poll_feed_spec tests never actually fail even if the guarded code they're supposed to test is deleted entirely, because they don't stub the other required guard conditions (feed_polling_enabled?), so they test the stub defaults rather than the code.
issues.zh: poll_feed_spec 的兩個測試不會失敗：受測的判斷整段刪掉也照樣通過，因為沒有 stub 前置條件。

issues.text: poll_feed's main body (the item-processing loop) is entirely mocked out via poller.expects(:poll_feed) in every test, so it has zero real test coverage and issues like missing sanitize or missing nil handling are invisible to CI.
issues.zh: 整份 spec 都用 poller.expects(:poll_feed) 把 poll_feed 本體 stub 掉，本體從來沒有被實際執行過，缺 sanitize 與缺 nil 防護在 CI 上都不會被攔到。

issues.text: Kernel#open (via open-uri) is used directly on the feed_polling_url site setting string with no scheme validation, so a value starting with | executes a shell command and a local file path reads local files, and an internal URL becomes SSRF.
issues.zh: open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url) 讓一個 site setting 字串同時具備讀本機檔案與執行指令的能力，也是完全沒有防護的 SSRF。

issues.text: poll_feed has no nil guard on remote feed item fields and no rescue around the per-item processing, and combined with sidekiq_options retry: false, a single malformed item silently halts the entire polling run every time with no signal to operators.
issues.zh: poll_feed 對遠端資料沒有任何 nil 防護或 rescue，配上 sidekiq_options retry: false，單一則壞掉的 item 會讓整輪 polling 靜默停擺。

issues.text: TopicEmbed.import's check-then-create pattern doesn't handle the unique index conflict; concurrent imports of overlapping URLs can hit RecordNotUnique inside a transaction, rolling back the whole batch and aborting the polling loop.
issues.zh: TopicEmbed.import 的 check-then-create 沒有處理 unique index 衝突，兩個並行的匯入會讓其中一個整批 rollback。

issues.text: best.html.erb has an extra `if` in `<%- end if %>` which is only saved from being a SyntaxError by an incidental quirk of the Erubis template compiler; switching template engines or Rails versions could break it.
issues.zh: best.html.erb 的 <%- end if %> 多了一個 if，靠 Erubis 的編碼細節才沒有變成 SyntaxError。

issues.text: The X-Frame-Options header is set to the non-standard value ALLOWALL, whose behavior across browsers is unpredictable, and there is no other place in the repo it needs to override.
issues.zh: X-Frame-Options 設成非標準值 ALLOWALL，這個 header 在本 repo 裡沒有預設值可以覆蓋，行為不可預測。

issues.text: TopicEmbed.import mutates the caller's contents string argument in place via String#<<, an implicit side effect not indicated by the method's name or signature.
issues.zh: TopicEmbed.import 就地修改傳入的 contents 參數，是隱性副作用。

issues.text: Jobs::PollFeed#feed_key is defined but never called anywhere in the codebase, appearing to be unfinished dead code for a conditional-GET caching feature that isn't in this MR.
issues.zh: Jobs::PollFeed#feed_key 定義後從未被呼叫。

issues.text: require_dependency is used on a gem (nokogiri) instead of a plain require; require_dependency is meant for autoloaded app code, not gems.
issues.zh: require_dependency 用在 gem 上（nokogiri），對一個 gem 使用它沒有意義。

issues.text: retrieve_topic.rb has an unused require_dependency 'email/sender' that the file never references.
issues.zh: app/jobs/regular/retrieve_topic.rb 的 require_dependency 'email/sender' 整個檔案都沒有用到。

issues.text: Four new files are missing a trailing newline at end of file.
issues.zh: 四個新檔案缺檔尾換行。

issues.text: An unrelated migration file (migrate_word_counts.rb) has a purely whitespace-only diff (trailing whitespace and trailing newline removed) that has nothing to do with the embedding feature.
issues.zh: db/migrate/20131210181901_migrate_word_counts.rb 在本次 diff 裡的全部變動就是刪掉行尾空白與檔尾換行，跟 embedding 功能毫無關係。

issues.text: Only one of the three Gemfile lockfiles (Gemfile_rails4.lock) was updated with the new gems, so installs using the RAILS3 or RAILS_MASTER lockfiles will be out of sync with the Gemfile.
issues.zh: 三支 lockfile 只更新了一支，RAILS3 與 RAILS_MASTER 兩條路徑會裝不到新 gem。

issues.text: embed.js does not null-check the result of getElementById('discourse-comments') before appending to it, so a host page missing that container throws a TypeError that silently aborts the whole script.
issues.zh: embed.js 取 document.getElementById('discourse-comments') 之後沒有 null 檢查，宿主頁面漏了那個容器就會丟 TypeError 中斷整支 script。

issues.text: embed.js silently requires discourseUrl to end with a trailing slash (undocumented), otherwise the constructed URL is malformed (e.g. http://forum.example.comembed/best).
issues.zh: discourseUrl + "embed/best?..." 要求 discourseUrl 必須以 / 結尾，否則會拼出錯誤的 URL，且這件事沒有任何文件說明。

open_questions.text: Is the varchar(255) length of topic_embeds.embed_url sufficient for real-world URLs to be imported, given there's no length truncation and overly long URLs would abort the create inside a transaction?
open_questions.zh: topic_embeds.embed_url 用 t.string（PostgreSQL 的 varchar(255)）夠不夠裝實際要匯入的 URL？

open_questions.text: Is TopicRetriever synchronously running a full PollFeed cycle on every new embed request an intentional design choice, or an unintended amplification given it can trigger N full polling runs for N concurrent new URLs?
open_questions.zh: TopicRetriever 在 feed polling 開啟時同步跑一整輪 PollFeed，是刻意的設計還是沒有預期到的放大？

open_questions.text: Is it intentional that embed/best redirects to the login page on forums with login_required enabled, rather than supporting anonymous embedding?
open_questions.zh: 在開啟 login_required 的私密論壇上，embed/best 被導向登入頁是刻意的嗎？
